package day1;

public class Weekly_Assignment_26_09 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		//program to store and print the employee details
		int id=1001;
		int age=28;
		float salary=55000.50F;
		char department='T';
		boolean permanent=true;
		System.out.println("Employee ID:"+id);
		System.out.println("Age:"+age);
		System.out.println("Salary:"+salary);
		System.out.println("Department:"+department);
		System.out.println("Permanent:"+permanent);
		
		
		//program to calculate total price using the variables and print
		
		float productprice=499.50F;
		int quantity=3;
		float totalprice=productprice*quantity;
		System.out.println("Product Price:"+productprice);
		System.out.println("Quantity:"+quantity);
		System.out.println("Total Price:"+totalprice);
	}

}
